scope_limits.default_upload: 20 MB / 80 pages; PDFs, single PNG or JPEG; encrypted PDFs rejected
scope_limits.case_access: All members of an organization can access its active cases; no per-case private sharing
scope_limits.summary: Retrieved pages and total page count are displayed; summary coverage is not guaranteed to include every page
scope_limits.no_ai: Exact excerpts and deterministic candidates only, clearly labelled; not full semantic understanding
scope_limits.sources: Starter manifest is procedural portal discovery, not a complete approved legal corpus
scope_limits.legal: Does not file replies, make payments, calculate limitation periods or certify legal advice
scope_limits.audit: Application audit table, not immutable/tamper-proof against database administrators
scope_limits.performance: No production latency, cost, accuracy or throughput SLA is claimed
